name: OSS_RATING_CHARGE_DETERMINANTS
description: This table is used to capture rate plan charge determinants.

columns.name: CHARGE_DETERMINANT_ID
columns.description: This field uniquely identifies the specific rate plan charge determinant associated with each row in the dataset.

columns.name: CHARGE_DETERMINANT_PUID
columns.description: This field acts as an alternative identifier for the rate plan charge determinant associated with the row.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_DETERMINANT_ID
columns.description: This field uniquely identifies the specific rate plan determinant associated with each row in the dataset.

columns.name: RATE_PLAN_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the rate plan ID associated with the rate plan charge determinant. It links each charge determinant to its specific rate plan, ensuring that the correct charges are applied within the framework of the designated plan.

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the charge definition ID associated with the rate plan charge determinant. It links each charge determinant to a specific charge definition, ensuring that the correct rules, rates, and parameters are applied when calculating charges within a rate plan.

columns.name: PRICING_TIER_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the price tier associated with the rate plan charge determinant. It indicates the specific pricing level or bracket that applies to the charge determinant within the rate plan.

columns.name: DETERMINANT_GROUP_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Obsoleted : This field tracks the determinant group criteria ID associated with the rate plan charge determinant. It links each charge determinant to a specific group of criteria used to determine how charges are applied within the rate plan.

columns.name: UOM
columns.description: This field tracks the usage unit of measure associated with the rate plan charge determinant.

columns.name: UOM_CLASS
columns.description: This field tracks the class of usage unit of measure associated with the rate plan charge determinant.

columns.name: CHARGE_PERIOD
columns.description: This field tracks the charge period associated with the rate plan charge determinant.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: The "Usage Charge Start Time" field captures the exact start time for a usage charge within a specific rate plan.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: The "Usage Charge End Time" field records the exact end time of a usage charge within a specific rate plan.

columns.name: PRICING_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: This field tracks the name of the pricing entity like Line, Header

columns.name: PRICING_QUANTITY_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: This field tracks the quantity based attribute of the pricing entity

columns.name: PRICING_QUANTITY_UOM_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: This field tracks the unit of measure based attribute of the pricing entity

columns.name: REPORTED_QUANTITY_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: The "Reported Quantity" field is used to capture the specific quantity value reported for a usage event.

columns.name: REPORTED_QUANTITY_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of reported quantity attribute of the pricing entity

columns.name: REPORTED_UOM_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: The "Reported Unit of Measure" field captures the specific unit of measure (UOM) as reported for a usage event.

columns.name: REPORTED_UOM_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of reported unit of measure attribute of the pricing entity.

columns.name: BASE_RATE_TABLE_MATRIX_ID
columns.description: The "Pricing Matrix Identifier" field uniquely identifies the specific pricing matrix used by the system to calculate the base price for a usage event.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_MATRIX_ID
columns.description: The "Pricing Adjustment Matrix ID" field serves as a foreign key that links to the Pricing Model Header entity.

columns.name: TIER_HEADER_ID
columns.description: The "Tiered Pricing Header ID" field serves as a foreign key that links a record to the Tiered Pricing Header entity

columns.name: TIER_BASIS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The "Tier Basis Type Code" field tracks the volume attribute of the transaction that is used for tier evaluation within a tiered pricing model.

columns.name: TIER_BASIS_ID
columns.description: The "Tier Basis ID" field indicates the specific charge or set of charges against which the tier basis will be evaluated when the Tier Basis Type is Amount.

columns.name: TIER_TYPE
columns.description: The "Tier Type" field tracks the specific tier rules that are applied to either the quantity or the amount during the tiered pricing evaluation.

columns.name: PARTIAL_BLOCK_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The "Partial Block Action Code" field tracks how the pricing is calculated in the tiered pricing model, specifically whether it is based on a per unit or block approach.

columns.name: PRICE_LIST_CHARGE_ID
columns.description: The "Price List Charge ID" field tracks the unique identifier for a specific charge within a price list.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
